name: tapeout
description: A game that trains you to be a competitive semiconductor engineer: RTL, verification, timing closure, PCB layout.

scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run desktop:prep && electron desktop/main.cjs --dev
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:prep && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.desktop:dir: npm run desktop:prep && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml --dir --publish never
